verdict.rationale: Honeycomb supports background automations via Triggers and SLOs that continuously evaluate conditions and fire alerts, plus an API to programmatically manage these automations — these run autonomously without user intervention. However, there is no evidence of AI-driven or agentic automation that acts autonomously (e.g., an agent scheduling investigations, auto-remediating, or running background tasks); the MCP integration is interactive (agent queries on request) rather than an autonomous background process. Missing for 10: evidence of AI/agent-initiated autonomous background workflows, scheduled agentic tasks, or autonomous remediation beyond static threshold-based triggers/SLOs.
